about.subhead: PHP and Vue by day, Lightroom and shaders by night.

parts.heading: Who I am
body: I’m Manuel, from the Basel region. Deep in PHP and Vue at work, camera, Photoshop and anything between code and image on the side.

Since November 2021, I’ve worked at zvoove Switzerland AG on business software for staffing companies. I design and build Vue interfaces for complex workflows, develop PHP endpoints and help maintain integrations and data synchronisation.
I also take responsibility for a Cypress suite of around 30 extensive release tests, from writing and running tests to analysing failures. Migration to Playwright is in progress.

parts.heading: How I started
body: Gaming got me into programming. I set up my own Minecraft modpack server and programmed mining turtles in Lua. That made me want to understand what was happening under the hood.
From 2016 to 2020, I completed an IT apprenticeship at Novartis. Servers, networks and support gave me a broad foundation. After civilian service, I moved into application development.

parts.heading: How I work with AI
body: I work a lot with Codex and Claude Code: custom skills, agents, MCP integrations. The idea, the taste and the final say stay with me, the AI just types faster. Whatever comes out gets reviewed, tested and often rebuilt.
That’s how the club platform and this portfolio came about. I know React and TypeScript from these projects; design, scope and operation are on me.

parts.heading: What motivates me
body: Curiosity. I like trying new tools, polishing small visual details and knowing how things work. If the club actually ends up using the result, even better.

parts.heading: Away from the screen
body: For wildlife shots I’ll fly solo to Costa Rica or Thailand and then sit in the bushes with the camera for hours. There’s also my Audi S5 tuning project, skiing, snowboarding and diving. At Jogge di Balla, I’m a co-founder and vice president and help with events, photos and videos. And there’s still that zvoove ping-pong champion title to chase.

caseStudy.headline: A club idea grew into a platform.
caseStudy.hook: I built a dedicated club and event platform for Jogge di Balla over several months. It combines the public website, internal administration and tools for events. I continue to develop and operate it.

context.label: My contribution
story: The idea started during the pandemic: four friends, little going on, so we put on unusual events of our own. That became Jogge di Balla in August 2022, with events such as Schlag den Kassier, Silvester 2.0, Harassenlauf and Lotto-Party.

As co-founder and vice president, I help with events, photography and video. And because I like building things myself, the club got its own platform: I take care of design, development and operation. Managing members and supporters, reviewing attendance, sending orders to the kitchen and bar: all of it runs through there today.

items.title: Admin, POS and stream in one app
items.lede: Member management and event operations run through the same platform, with the same roles.
items.screenshotAlt: Admin dashboard with permissions card and member list

features.title: Permissions and memberships
features.body: Configurable role permissions, supporting memberships with payment status and attendance reports reflect the club’s day-to-day needs.

features.title: Order and point-of-sale system
features.body: Prices come from the server, never the client. Orders freeze their item data, so a price change never rewrites an old bill.

features.title: Media and events
features.body: Image processing and a moderated live slideshow complement event management, statistics and streaming tools.

items.title: «Schlag den Kassier» on stream
items.lede: One example of the event tools: an overlay brings scores and the club’s visual identity to the live stream.
items.screenshotAlt: Twitch overlay during stream with live score and club design

features.title: Browser-based control
features.body: A separate control panel manages the display, which is embedded in OBS as a browser source.

features.title: Synchronised scores
features.body: The overlay regularly fetches the latest scores and updates the display without reloading.

features.title: Math for the crowd
features.body: Winner display and the calculation of when a lead becomes unbeatable, so the hosts don't have to do the math in their heads.

reflection.label: What I learned
reflection.body: A real club is the best QA team: every event finds a new edge case. That's why there are automated tests, and why the root server is mine to run.
